## Summary Greenfield build of Conduit: a NestJS + Prisma/Postgres JWT API and an Angular SPA implementing the RealWorld article/comment/favorite/follow feature set, containerized and deployed as two Kubernetes services. ## Scope ### Files to modify - `README.md` — replace stub with setup, env vars, and local-dev instructions. ### Files to create **Repo root** - `docker-compose.yml` — local Postgres + backend + frontend. - `.env.example` — `DATABASE_URL`, `JWT_SECRET`, `PORT`. - `.gitignore`, `.dockerignore`. **Backend — `backend/`** - `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `nest-cli.json`, `.eslintrc.js` - `Dockerfile` — multi-stage: build → runtime node:20-alpine, `CMD` runs `docker-entrypoint.sh`. - `docker-entrypoint.sh` — `prisma migrate deploy && node dist/prisma/seed.js && node dist/src/main.js`. - `prisma/schema.prisma` — User, Article, Comment, Tag, ArticleTag, Favorite, Follow. - `prisma/seed.ts` — idempotent upsert of jake + article + tags + comment. - `src/main.ts` — bootstrap, global `ValidationPipe`, CORS, global prefix `api`, `PORT` (default 3000). - `src/app.module.ts` - `src/prisma/prisma.module.ts`, `src/prisma/prisma.service.ts` - `src/health/health.controller.ts` — `GET /api/health`, `GET /api/health/deep` (`SELECT 1`). - `src/auth/` — `auth.module.ts`, `auth.service.ts`, `auth.controller.ts`, `jwt.strategy.ts`, `jwt-auth.guard.ts`, `optional-jwt-auth.guard.ts`, `current-user.decorator.ts`, `dto/register.dto.ts`, `dto/login.dto.ts`, `dto/update-user.dto.ts` - `src/articles/` — `articles.module.ts`, `articles.service.ts`, `articles.controller.ts`, `dto/create-article.dto.ts`, `dto/update-article.dto.ts`, `dto/list-articles.query.ts`, `article.view.ts` (response shaper) - `src/comments/` — `comments.module.ts`, `comments.service.ts`, `comments.controller.ts`, `dto/create-comment.dto.ts` - `src/profiles/` — `profiles.module.ts`, `profiles.service.ts`, `profiles.controller.ts` - `src/tags/` — `tags.module.ts`, `tags.service.ts`, `tags.controller.ts` - `src/common/slug.util.ts` — `slugify(title)`. - `test/conduit.e2e-spec.ts`, `test/jest-e2e.json` **Frontend — `frontend/`** - `package.json`, `angular.json`, `tsconfig*.json` - `Dockerfile` — build → `nginx:alpine`. - `nginx.conf` — SPA fallback `try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html`; `location /api/ { proxy_pass http://conduit-backend:3000; }`. - `src/index.html` — `Conduit`, `Conduit`. - `src/styles.css` — RealWorld-like layout/typography. - `src/main.ts`, `src/app/app.config.ts` (standalone bootstrap, `provideRouter`, `provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([authInterceptor]))`) - `src/app/app.routes.ts` - `src/app/core/` — `auth.service.ts`, `api.service.ts`, `article.service.ts`, `profile.service.ts`, `tag.service.ts`, `auth.interceptor.ts`, `auth.guard.ts`, `models.ts` - `src/app/layout/` — `header.component.ts`, `footer.component.ts` - `src/app/pages/` — `home/`, `login/`, `register/`, `article/`, `editor/`, `profile/`, `settings/` - `src/app/shared/` — `article-list.component.ts`, `article-preview.component.ts`, `comment-card.component.ts`, `confirm-modal.component.ts`, `tag-list.component.ts` **Deployment — `k8s/`** - `postgres.yaml` — StatefulSet + Service + PVC. - `backend.yaml` — Deployment (`conduit-backend`, port 3000, liveness `/api/health`, readiness `/api/health/deep`) + Service + Secret refs. - `frontend.yaml` — Deployment (`conduit-frontend`, port 80) + Service. - `ingress.yaml` — routes `/` → frontend. ### Dependencies - Backend: `@nestjs/common|core|platform-express|config|jwt|passport`, `passport`, `passport-jwt`, `@prisma/client`, `prisma`, `bcryptjs`, `class-validator`, `class-transformer`, `slugify`; dev: `typescript`, `jest`, `supertest`, `ts-node`. - Frontend: `@angular/core|common|router|forms|platform-browser` v17+ (standalone), `rxjs`. - Infra: Postgres 16, nginx:alpine, node:20-alpine. ### Integrations None — no third-party APIs or SDKs. ### Assumptions - **Greenfield.** No stack existed; the spec's Non-functional section is authoritative. - **Auth model = `full_auth`** with public read. Public routes: `/`, `/login`, `/register`, `/article/:slug`, `/profile/:username`, `/api/health*`, plus all `GET` API endpoints. Guarded: `/editor`, `/editor/:slug`, `/settings`, and `?tab=feed`. - **Two containers.** nginx serves the Angular bundle and reverse-proxies `/api` to the backend, so the browser sees a same-origin API and no build-time URL config is needed. - **JWT** in `localStorage`, 7-day expiry, HS256. Backend accepts `Authorization: Token ` *and* `Bearer `; frontend sends `Bearer`. - **Slugs**: `slugify(title, {lower:true, strict:true}) + '-' + 6-char base36 suffix`, unique-indexed. - **First registered user is admin** — modeled as no role column (spec has no admin actor); registration is open per spec. - Pagination `limit=20&offset=0`; list responses `{ articles, articlesCount }`. - Password rule: min 8 chars, bcrypt cost 10. ## Implementation Plan ### Step 1: Repo scaffold **Files:** root `docker-compose.yml`, `.env.example`, `.gitignore`, `.dockerignore` **Change:** Create the two-workspace layout (`backend/`, `frontend/`). Compose brings up `db` (postgres:16, volume), `backend` (depends_on db, `DATABASE_URL=postgresql://conduit:conduit@db:5432/conduit`), `frontend` (port 4200→80). ### Step 2: Prisma schema and migration **File:** `backend/prisma/schema.prisma` **Change:** Model the spec's Data Model exactly. `User` (unique `username`, unique `email`, `passwordHash`, `bio` default `""`, `image` nullable). `Article` (unique `slug`, `title`, `description`, `body`, `authorId` FK cascade, timestamps). `Comment` (`body`, `articleId` cascade, `authorId`, `createdAt`). `Tag` (unique `name`). `ArticleTag` (composite PK, both cascade). `Favorite` (composite PK `[userId, articleId]`). `Follow` (composite PK `[followerId, followedId]`, self-relations `following`/`followers`). Generate initial migration. ### Step 3: Prisma service + health **Files:** `backend/src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`, `backend/src/health/health.controller.ts` **Change:** `PrismaService extends PrismaClient implements OnModuleInit`. Health controller returns `{status:'ok'}`; deep variant runs `$queryRaw\`SELECT 1\`` and returns 503 on failure. ### Step 4: Auth module **Files:** `backend/src/auth/*` **Change:** `POST /api/users` (register: hash, create, return `{user:{email,token,username,bio,image}}`), `POST /api/users/login` (verify bcrypt, 401 on mismatch), `GET /api/user` + `PUT /api/user` (guarded). `JwtStrategy` extracts from both `Token` and `Bearer` prefixes, payload `{sub, username}`. `JwtAuthGuard` → 401 when absent. `OptionalJwtAuthGuard` attaches user when present, never throws — used by all public GETs so `favorited`/`following` flags resolve. ### Step 5: Articles module **Files:** `backend/src/articles/*`, `backend/src/common/slug.util.ts` **Change:** - `GET /api/articles` (optional auth) — filters `tag`, `author`, `favorited`, `limit`, `offset`; ordered `createdAt desc`. - `GET /api/articles/feed` (guarded) — articles by followed authors. - `GET /api/articles/:slug` (optional auth) — 404 if missing. - `POST /api/articles` (guarded) — generate slug, upsert tags, link `ArticleTag`. - `PUT`/`DELETE /api/articles/:slug` (guarded) — **throw `ForbiddenException` (403) if `article.authorId !== user.id`, checked before any mutation**; regenerate slug only when title changes. - `POST`/`DELETE /api/articles/:slug/favorite` (guarded) — create/delete `Favorite`, return updated article. - `article.view.ts` shapes `{slug,title,description,body,tagList,createdAt,updatedAt,favorited,favoritesCount,author:{username,bio,image,following}}`. ### Step 6: Comments module **File:** `backend/src/comments/*` **Change:** `GET /api/articles/:slug/comments` (optional auth), `POST` (guarded), `DELETE /api/articles/:slug/comments/:id` (guarded, 403 unless comment author). Responses include author profile and `createdAt`. ### Step 7: Profiles and tags **Files:** `backend/src/profiles/*`, `backend/src/tags/*` **Change:** `GET /api/profiles/:username` (optional auth, includes `following`), `POST`/`DELETE /api/profiles/:username/follow` (guarded, 404 on unknown user, no self-follow). `GET /api/tags` returns `{tags:[...]}` ordered by usage count desc, limit 20 — this backs the "Popular Tags" sidebar. ### Step 8: Seed **File:** `backend/prisma/seed.ts` **Change:** Idempotent upserts — user `jake` (`jake@demo`, bcrypt of `Demo1234!`, bio `"I work at statefarm"`); article `"How to train your dragon"` (description `"Ever wonder how?"`, body, slug `how-to-train-your-dragon`) tagged `dragons` + `training`; one comment on it. Add 2–3 extra untagged articles so "filtering by tag" is visibly exercised. Safe to re-run on every container start. ### Step 9: Angular shell, routing, auth plumbing **Files:** `frontend/src/index.html`, `app.routes.ts`, `core/*`, `layout/header.component.ts` **Change:** Standalone bootstrap. Header renders the brand **"Conduit"** always; shows Home/Sign in/Sign up when anonymous and Home/New Article/Settings/**username** when authenticated. `AuthService` holds a `currentUser` signal hydrated from `localStorage` on boot. `authInterceptor` attaches `Bearer`. `authGuard` redirects to `/login?redirect=`. Routes (each with `data.flow`): - `''` → HomeComponent — `?tab=global|feed&tag=&page=`, all state read from and written to query params. - `'login'`, `'register'`, `'settings'` (guarded), `'editor'` (guarded), `'editor/:slug'` (guarded) - `'article/:slug'` — `?modal=delete-article|delete-comment&commentId=` - `'profile/:username'` with children `''` (authored) and `'favorites'` ### Step 10: Home page **File:** `frontend/src/app/pages/home/` **Change:** Banner with "Conduit" + tagline. Feed tabs: **"Your Feed"** (auth only) and **"Global Feed"** (literal label, required marker). A third tab appears as `#tag` when `?tag=` is set. Sidebar `

Popular Tags

` (literal marker) rendering `/api/tags`; clicking a tag sets `?tag=`, which triggers the filtered fetch. Article previews show author, date, title, description, favorite count button. ### Step 11: Article, editor, profile, settings pages **Files:** `frontend/src/app/pages/{article,editor,profile,settings}/` **Change:** - Article: title banner, author + follow button, favorite button, rendered body, tag list, comment form (auth) / "Sign in to add comments" link (anon), comment cards with author + timestamp, delete icon on own comments. Edit/Delete controls only when `author.username === currentUser.username`; delete opens `?modal=delete-article`. - Editor: reactive form (title, description, body, tags), create vs update by `:slug`, redirects to `/article/:slug`. - Profile: username, bio, image, Follow/Edit-profile button, child tabs "My Articles" / "Favorited Articles". - Settings: bio/image/email/username/password form + "Or click here to logout". ### Step 12: Containers and k8s **Files:** `backend/Dockerfile`, `backend/docker-entrypoint.sh`, `frontend/Dockerfile`, `frontend/nginx.conf`, `k8s/*.yaml` **Change:** Backend image copies `prisma/` and `dist/`, entrypoint runs migrate+seed then boots. Frontend image copies `dist/frontend/browser/` into `/usr/share/nginx/html` — **verify the Angular v17 output path (`browser/` subdir) matches the `COPY` line**. nginx proxies `/api/` to `conduit-backend:3000`. k8s manifests wire `DATABASE_URL`/`JWT_SECRET` from a Secret and set the health probes. ### Step 13: Tests **Files:** `backend/test/conduit.e2e-spec.ts` **Change:** Cover the spec's scenarios: login as jake succeeds; register creates+returns token; unauthenticated POST article/comment/favorite/follow → **401**; second user editing jake's article → **403** and article unchanged; tag filter returns only tagged articles; favorite increments count and appears in favorited list; follow makes author's articles appear in `/feed`; comment create then delete. ## Testing Strategy - `docker compose up` → hit `http://localhost:4200`, confirm all four markers render: "Conduit", "Global Feed", "How to train your dragon", "Popular Tags". - `curl localhost:3000/api/health/deep` → 200 after migrations. - Backend e2e (`npm run test:e2e`) against a throwaway Postgres, asserting the status codes above. - Manual flow: register → publish tagged article → confirm it appears in Global Feed and under its tag → comment → favorite → follow jake → confirm Your Feed populates. - Verify 401 vs 403 distinction explicitly — a common source of silent failure. ## Risks - **Angular 17+ build output path** moved to `dist//browser`; a stale `COPY` line yields an nginx 403/404 and zero markers. Confirm before deploying. - **Seed idempotency** — a non-upsert seed crashes the container on pod restart. All seed writes must be `upsert`/`skipDuplicates`. - **Migration race** if the backend scales beyond one replica; keep `replicas: 1` or move migration to an initContainer/Job. - **403 vs 404 ordering** — ownership must be checked after existence, or a missing article returns the wrong code. - **Tag filter correctness** — the join through `ArticleTag` must not duplicate articles carrying multiple matched tags; use `some` on the relation, not a raw join. - **Slug regeneration on title edit** breaks existing links; acceptable, but the editor must navigate to the new slug after save. - No Postgres in the repo yet — the k8s Secret for `JWT_SECRET` must be provisioned by the deploy pipeline or the backend will boot with an insecure default.
